high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from eurasiantimes.com titled "Unraveling The Incident." The article discusses a historical incident involving Soviet submarines and US vessels during the Cold War era. It specifically notes that the USSR's submarine K-314 had been tailing a carrier for several days before the collision.
